SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM c2k_account a JOIN c2k_role_permission p ON p.role_id = a.role OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM c2k_member_role m WHERE m.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND m.member_id = a.id AND m.role_id = p.role_id ) WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.id = #{memberId} AND a.enabled ORDER BY p.permission_code
SELECT code, name, description FROM c2k_permission ORDER BY code
SELECT id, tenant_id, name, description, built_in, revision FROM c2k_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR built_in ORDER BY built_in DESC, name, id
SELECT id, tenant_id, name, description, built_in, revision FROM c2k_role WHERE id = #{id} AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR built_in)
SELECT permission_code FROM c2k_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{id} ORDER BY permission_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_role (id, tenant_id, name, description) VALUES (#{role.id}, #{role.tenantId}, #{role.name}, #{role.description})
mapper.update: UPDATE c2k_role SET name = #{role.name}, description = #{role.description}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{role.id} AND tenant_id = #{role.tenantId} AND NOT built_in AND revision = #{role.revision}

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM c2k_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND NOT built_in
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM c2k_member_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY role_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_member_role (tenant_id, member_id, role_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{roleId})
